note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown and only the soldier and worker are described; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated; one index based on soldier head-capsule width is incomplete in the OCR source and is omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown or dark brown; antennae brown, darker distally; mandibles dark brown with yellowish brown bases; pronotum slightly paler than the head capsule; legs yellow to rusty yellow; abdomen yellow to pale yellowish brown. Cephalic and thoracic pilosity moderate, abdominal pilosity denser, each tergite with a row of setae along the posterior margin and a few irregularly arranged setae in front of it. Body length 3.70–4.90 mm. Head capsule broadly oval, longer than wide (head length to mandible bases 1.38–1.60, maximum width 1.30–1.38 mm); sides strongly narrowed anteriorly (width at mandible bases/maximum width index 0.625). Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2 or segment 4, segment 4 shorter than segment 2, segment 5 subequal to segment 3. Labrum broadly ligulate, longer than wide (length 0.35–0.38, width 0.30–0.33 mm), apex rounded or with a shallow point. Mandibles short and robust, sickle-shaped, distinctly incurved near the apex, about half the head length (length 0.80–0.84 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.51–0.52). Left mandible with a prominent pointed tooth at the apical quarter (tooth 0.20 mm from the apex, tooth distance/mandible length index 0.24–0.25); right mandible with a small vestigial tooth slightly behind the corresponding tooth of the left mandible. Postmentum subrectangular, sides narrowed in the anterior quarter, posterior part nearly parallel (length 0.90–0.93, maximum width 0.60–0.63 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped with a distinct notch, posterior margin concave; mesonotum slightly narrower than the pronotum with a median notch on the posterior margin; metanotum slightly wider than the pronotum with a nearly straight posterior margin.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers monomorphic. Head capsule and postclypeus yellow, antennae yellow, gradually darker distally to pale brown. Cephalic and body pilosity relatively dense. Body length 4.5–5.20 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than the head length to the mandible bases (head length to mandible bases 1.45–1.60, maximum width 1.58–1.75 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 18–19-segmented. Postclypeus inflated and setose, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.50–0.55, maximum width 0.75–0.90 mm), anterior lobe strongly upturned and semicircular, anterior margin strongly concave; posterior margin convex and strongly concave. Mesonotum slightly narrower than the pronotum, posterior margin concave medially; metanotum wider than the pronotum, posterior margin convex.
